title: DriftGuard Semantic Evaluation Result
description: Structured output a future semantic evaluator may return for one semantic_condition against one answer. The result reports only what the answer does and does not support. It carries no compliance verdict, no audit opinion, and no certification decision: those conclusions belong to a service auditor, not to DriftGuard. The assessment vocabulary is deliberately phrased in terms of support rather than pass or fail.

assessment.description: SUPPORTED: every required element is evidenced. PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED: some required elements evidenced, some not. INSUFFICIENT: the answer does not evidence the required elements. UNDETERMINED: the evaluator could not reach a view, for example because the answer was off-topic or unintelligible. None of these is a compliance conclusion.

confidence.description: Evaluator confidence in its own assessment, not a measure of the entity's compliance.

present_elements.description: Element IDs the answer evidences. Every entry must exist in the referenced semantic_condition.

missing_elements.description: Element IDs the answer does not evidence. Every entry must exist in the referenced semantic_condition and must not also appear in present_elements.

reason_codes.description: Controlled vocabulary explaining the assessment. Enumerated rather than free text so the explanation is stable and cannot smuggle in a verdict.

needs_human_review.description: Whether a person should confirm the assessment before it informs anything the entity sees.

x-prohibited-verdicts.description: Values the result must never carry anywhere in the record. Enforced by the validator, not only by the assessment enum.
